Place Chinese TTF fonts here for PDF export:

Required file names (recommended):
- NotoSansSC-Regular.ttf
- NotoSansSC-Bold.ttf

Alternative supported names:
- SourceHanSansCN-Regular.ttf
- SourceHanSansCN-Bold.ttf

The exporter will auto-load these files from:
/static/libs/pdfmake/fonts/

If no Chinese font is found, exporter falls back to Roboto and Chinese may show as tofu boxes.
